dimension_b_drift.title: Prepare Payment Instructions reads legacy path `Create User Record` directly instead of Prepare WF-52 Payload output
dimension_b_drift.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-22.md:77 — jsCode: `const userData = $('Create User Record').first().json; const phone = userData.phone_number;` reads snake_case `phone_number` from the Create User Record RETURNING row, not from the canonical `Prepare WF-52 Payload` output. Pseudo Step 9 says 'phoneNumber = user's phone' without specifying source.
dimension_b_drift.recommended_action: No functional defect (the DB RETURNING row does contain phone_number), but pseudo Step 9 should explicitly document that Prepare Payment Instructions reads from Create User Record directly (not from the WF-52 Payload set node), to avoid confusion about whether the canonical phoneNumber rename is in scope for this node. Low priority — parking as follow-up.

dimension_c_md.title: Create User Record gained `onError:continueRegularOutput` — unintended functional change not in sub-10 plan
dimension_c_md.evidence: docs/pseudocode/WF-22.md diff hunk at line 30-34: `{"onError":"continueRegularOutput"}` added to Create User Record error handling. sub-10.md `node_modifications: []` lists zero modifications to existing nodes.
dimension_c_md.recommended_action: Verify whether this error-handling change was intentional or a side-effect of the n8n edit. If the UPSERT fails (e.g. constraint error beyond phone_number conflict), `continueRegularOutput` silently passes an empty/error JSON downstream to `Prepare WF-52 Payload`, which would then emit `phoneNumber=undefined, name=undefined, userId=undefined` — causing WF-52's entry guard to throw. Recommend changing to `onError:stopWorkflow` (n8n default) or explicitly documenting the intent in sub-10.md if the behaviour is desired.

dimension_c_md.title: Set node typeVersion in .md is 3.4 but sub-10.md plan specifies typeVersion 3
dimension_c_md.recommended_action: v3.4 is a minor-version bump within the v3 family — functionally equivalent. No action required; noted for awareness.

questions_for_human: Was the `onError:continueRegularOutput` addition to Create User Record intentional? It is not listed in sub-10.md's node_modifications and changes the failure mode: a DB UPSERT error would silently propagate downstream rather than stopping the workflow. If intentional, update sub-10.md to document the rationale.
